subject: Connector vendor roster and cross-border transfer paths — please confirm
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: connectors roster + explicit transfer paths for FinCloud integration

Hi Logan —

As part of our security review for the upcoming Redwood integration, Legal and Security asked us to get an explicit list of third-party connectors (subprocessors) that will touch FinCloud customer data and the cross-border transfer paths for each connector. Specifically we need: 

- A current roster of connector vendors (name, primary function) that Redwood may route FinCloud data through for the integration
- For each vendor: which country(ies) their processing occurs in and whether any exports to non-EU regions occur (if so, what safeguards)
- Any onshore fallback or regional routing options you support for EU customers
- Links to the SOC 2 or equivalent evidence for those vendors (or confirmation they are covered by Redwood's attestations)

We are on a tight timeline for our compliance board — could you send the roster and a simple map/PDF of transfer paths by EOD Wednesday (11/11)? If you have a DPA subprocessor amendment we can sign, please include that too.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Security Engineer — FinCloud
liam.oconnor@fincloud.com

Attachment: none

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fincloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: connectors roster + explicit transfer paths for FinCloud integration

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a first-pass roster and a transfer-path diagram for the connector set we expect FinCloud to touch during the pilot. High-level notes below: 

- Attached: redwood_subprocessor_roster_v1.xlsx (vendor, function, processing jurisdictions) and crossborder-map-FinCloud.pdf (visual routes by region).
- Most telemetry and analytics connectors process in EU-only clusters for EU customers by default. Where we have global vendors (e.g., EdgeSight Analytics) they operate EU endpoints; we also offer explicit onshore routing for customers that require it.
- Encryption & KMS: we use customer-region KMS where configured. KMS/HSM sourcing details are in the roster for each vendor.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains an internal bridge for vendor coverage. If a vendor is in the roster with "covered-by-redwood", that means Redwood's controls and vendor attestations are included in our SOC 2 catalogue.

Next steps: Kimberly will follow up with the export-control specifics and draft a short subprocessor amendment for signature. Can you confirm whether FinCloud requires a DocuSign packet up-front or prefer we attach the PDF to an email?

Logan
Logan Wright

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: connectors roster + explicit transfer paths for FinCloud integration

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the catch. Short answer: we do not route EU customer log payloads to EdgeSight's US staging cluster by default. EdgeSight operates EU-only processing for EU customers; the asterisk indicates they maintain a global monitoring pipeline for internal debugging that is opt-in and only used under controlled circumstances (e.g., customer-approved debug session). When enabled, those debug exports go to a restricted US staging environment and are covered by additional contractual safeguards (data minimization, time-limited access, MFA, restricted IP allowlist).

I've attached a concise subprocessor amendment PDF for signature — it covers the EdgeSight opt-in handling and the onshore fallback we mentioned earlier. If FinCloud prefers DocuSign, here's the packet: https://docusign.com/packet/abc123 (also attached below as a PDF stub). Jordan (procurement) is cc'd for purchase/DPA routing.

Requested actions:
- Priya / Liam: confirm if you want the amendment sent via DocuSign (recommended) or as an email attachment.
- If DocuSign, we can request countersignature within 48 hours once you confirm sign method.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Vendor Risk & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
